title: TTEOP — Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol: Specification and Reference Implementation
description: TTEOP (Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol) is an open, vendor-neutral interoperability standard for measuring AI-operator token efficiency. It defines four telemetry primitives (input, output, cache_write, cache_read), five derived metrics (Yield, Leverage, Velocity, output_fraction, log_leverage), three privacy modes, four provenance levels, a JSON Schema for telemetry envelopes, a conformance suite with frozen test vectors, and a governance process for protocol evolution. The reference implementation is written in JavaScript (Node.js >= 18) and published as the npm package tteop-spec.
